notes: Home arc for the DSD cinema overhaul. Q19 round (2026-09-06): showroom, ROSON and Denjoy merged into one beat; pre-delivery inspection removed; delivery became the installs marquee; after sales became the parts marquee; see us in action became a mixed marquee.

beats.headline: Nobody else touches your chair.
beats.body: We uncrate it, test it, drive it to your door, build it in your room, and come back when you call. One team from the crate to the handover, and the same team on the phone a year later.

beats.headline: Hundreds of dental chairs
beats.body: In clinics across the Philippines. Every one of them uncrated, tested and signed off in our warehouse before it left, then assembled in the operatory by our own technicians.

beats.headline: The real DentaSource.
beats.body: We laugh a lot and we lift for each other, on the showroom floor and on the long drives. When we walk into your clinic, you get all of us.

beats.headline: The largest dental showroom in the country, and the only door to three brands
beats.body: Open Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 8 PM. We are the exclusive Philippine distributor for ROSON and K-Clamps, and the exclusive Denjoy partner here, so the unit on our floor is the unit you receive, and the spares and the support stay in the country. Sit in them side by side in the same light before you choose.

beats.body: Our work starts after the invoice. We train beside your team, we keep learning with you, and we grow when your clinic grows.

place.note: Google Maps carries one pin for Mercedes Square Plaza and no separate pin for Plaza 2 or for the Training Center, so the embeds and the links address the coordinates rather than a place id. Google place photos are NOT copied onto the site, which the Maps terms forbid; the building is shown by EMBEDDING Street View, which stays served by Google. The cbp parameter is load bearing: without it the same svembed URL answers 200 and quietly renders a zoomed out WORLD MAP instead of a panorama, which is what it did on the first pass. With it the pano resolves to 1250 Luis, Pasig and shows the building frontage and the parking along it.

beats.headline: We travel the whole country to build it
beats.body: Luzon is served by our own van and our own installation team. Units bound for the Visayas and Mindanao go by freight with installation arranged on arrival. A free ocular visit comes first, so the unit fits the room before it ever leaves the warehouse.
beats.note: round 6: the tiles still come from installs.json and every reel the visual pass marked `road` is mixed in beside them, which is why this is the action panel rather than the image only installs panel. See HomeCinema.jsx.

beats.headline: The chair is the room, so downtime is the cost
beats.body: Our technicians assess a fault on site first, and we hold parts here for that reason. Handpiece lines, valves, upholstery, control boards and delivery arms are all serviceable. When the assessment says it will not clear quickly, a replacement unit goes out and the affected one comes back.

tradeIn.headline: Your old chair has value here
tradeIn.body: Almost any make or model counts toward a new ROSON chair, working or not. We appraise it, we collect it, and the new chair goes in the same day the old one comes out.

beats.headline: Something is always happening on the floor
beats.body: Installs, showroom days, conventions, courses and the odd thing that only happens once. We write it down the day it happens, from our own posts.

beats.headline: The ten questions we are asked most
beats.body: Price, installment, delivery outside Metro Manila, after sales, showroom hours, training, spare parts and installation time. The answers are here, and the inquiry form sits at the end of them.

beats.headline: Tap the glass. Hold to watch.
beats.body: Installs, conventions, training days and ordinary afternoons, all filmed by us and never stock. Every tap brings in a new marble.

beats.headline: Come and sit in the chair
beats.body: 610 C. Raymundo Avenue, Maybunga, Pasig City, Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 8 PM. No appointment needed, though telling us you are coming means the model you want is set up and powered when you arrive.
